reference_coordinate_frame: Ego-Vehicle Coordinate System at Camera Keyframe Timestamp (V_ego)

association_parameters.gate_classification: Exploratory assumptions (NOT validated or standard tracking thresholds)
association_parameters.methodology: Conservative spatial gating with Doppler consistency and strict mutual 1-to-1 isolation
association_parameters.justification_and_limitations: The 1.5 m spatial distance threshold and 2.5 m/s Doppler-difference threshold are exploratory assumptions derived from preliminary heuristics (assuming max relative speed <= 20 m/s over dt ≈ 75 ms). They are explicitly exploratory assumptions and are NOT claimed as validated, certified, or standard multi-object tracking thresholds.

doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.devkit_definition: vx_comp, vy_comp are the velocities in m/s compensated by the ego motion (nuscenes/utils/data_classes.py; x is front, y is left).
doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.sign_convention_status: Unverified in official devkit documentation (no explicit definition of approaching vs receding sign); neutral terminology 'compensated Doppler component' is strictly maintained.
doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.physical_interpretation: 1D scalar Doppler measurement along the radar line of sight projected onto the sensor x-axis.
doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.measurement_nature: Scalar line-of-sight velocity measurement only, NOT a complete 2D or 3D Cartesian velocity vector.
doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.sensor_angle_dependency: Because radial Doppler measures velocity along the sensor line-of-sight ray, returns at different azimuth angles (theta_1 != theta_2) have different projected Doppler values even if the target vehicle maintains constant Cartesian speed and heading. Conversely, separate objects at different bearings can coincidentally have identical Doppler values.
doppler_velocity_interpretation_and_angl.unmeasured_components: Transverse (cross-range) velocity is fundamentally unmeasured by a single Doppler radar beam. Kinematic forward-projection using vx_comp as a Cartesian velocity vector is physically invalid and is not performed.

multi_sweep_persistence.description: Candidate persistence chains maintaining unique 1-to-1 candidate associations continuously across all 3 sweeps (0 -> 1 -> 2); exploratory geometric links, NOT confirmed physical-object tracks.

documented_limitations: Candidate associations are exploratory geometric links and are NOT verified vehicle tracks.
The 1.5 m distance gate and 2.5 m/s Doppler gate are exploratory assumptions, NOT validated or standard tracking thresholds.

Radar Doppler velocity (vx_comp) is a 1D scalar compensated Doppler component; sign convention is not defined in official devkit documentation, transverse velocity is unmeasured, and 2D kinematic extrapolation is not valid.
Returns at different sensor line-of-sight angles exhibit different projected Doppler values even for constant vehicle velocity.
No precision, recall, MOTA, or identity consistency tracking performance metrics can be claimed without ground-truth return correspondence.
Radar cluster IDs are recycled hardware table slots (0-127) and do not represent persistent global track IDs.
Coordinate transformation into the reference ego frame compensates ego-motion, but does not compensate object motion or perform object tracking.
No collision prediction, crash probability, time-to-collision (TTC), or hazard thresholds are implemented.
